You are the planning module of a tabletop robot. Task specification: The objective is to clear the table by relocating all unassigned objects to designated zones. First, move the red_cup to the cyan_zone. Second, move the blue_book to the orange_zone. Success is achieved when both objects are no longer on the table surface and are correctly situated within their assigned zones.
Goals: [{"object": "red_cup", "zone": "cyan_zone"}, {"object": "blue_book", "zone": "orange_zone"}]

Current scene (from the camera):
{"table_z": 0.8, "objects": {"red_cup": {"kind": "cup", "center": [-0.1196, -0.1023, 0.8353], "top_z": 0.8706, "height": 0.0706, "footprint_long": 0.0468, "footprint_short": 0.0446, "long_axis_yaw": 0.785}, "blue_book": {"kind": "book", "center": [0.1157, -0.0316, 0.8124], "top_z": 0.8248, "height": 0.0248, "footprint_long": 0.0899, "footprint_short": 0.0581, "long_axis_yaw": 0.381}}, "zones": {"orange_zone": {"name": "orange_zone", "center": [0.013, -0.2306, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0577, 0.0596]}, "cyan_zone": {"name": "cyan_zone", "center": [-0.0614, 0.0149, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0577, 0.0595]}, "purple_zone": {"name": "purple_zone", "center": [-0.0242, 0.2138, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0576, 0.0576]}}, "gripper": {"width": 0.0796, "closed_command": false, "holding_something": false}, "end_effector": {"position": [-0.1979, -0.0005, 1.08], "yaw": 1.532}}

Order the goals into steps. A zone that is covered by an object must be cleared first (move that
object to its own destination). Skip objects that are already resting on their target zone.
Reply with JSON only:
{"steps": [{"object": "<object name>", "zone": "<zone name>"}, ...]}
